limitations: The sweep is exhaustive over E71's positive 5% grid, not the continuous allocation simplex.
Only the 2.00x cadence is phase-perturbed because E72's non-equal exact-grid exception occurred there.
Log phase and integer rounding do not cover batching, delayed labels, wall-clock scheduling, or correlated traffic.
Cross-grid geometric means retain E68-E72 scenario weighting and are descriptive rather than a production utility.
Every exact checkpoint sequence and allocation must still be preregistered; peeking between looks invalidates coverage.
model: Evaluate all 172 positive E71 alpha allocations over every unique E73 2.00x checkpoint phase/rounding grid. Select by cross-grid worst certification/drift ratio rather than one exact checkpoint lattice.

validation.base_grid_reproduction: All 172 allocations reproduce E72 2.00x certification and drift summaries.
validation.equal_control: Equal alpha has ratio one in every certification and drift case on every grid.
